ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME AND GENDER
Off Calendar Apr-14-2015 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name and Gender.
Dept. 514. Judge: Leslie C. Nichols; Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Mitch L. Lyon, #6840.

Petitioner Peter Edward Hernandez-Frisher, was present in pro per, placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Publication is not required.

No objections to the proposed change of name and gender were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to Ruby Aliza Hernandez-Frischer.

The Court further Orders that the gender of Ruby Aliza Hernandez-Frischer is changed from male to female.

Decree Changing Name and Gender was submitted to and signed by the Court.
